title: The privacy scan reports where, never what
assertion: In a repository holding personal email addresses, a home-folder path and an AWS access key in tracked and untracked (not ignored) files, `swerepo check --only security` fails, and its privacy finding is exactly a count of each kind, then the first ten places by file and line, in file and line order, then how many more there are: in the text report, in `--json`, and in the finding's own `--ci` annotation on GitHub Actions. `swerepo init --dry-run` gives the same finding in its plan. None of these outputs contains an address, the path, the user name, the key, or a fragment of any of them.

origin.text: ADR-20261122-a48e (Phase 4): the privacy scan's findings name the kind, file and line, never the matched text, because check output reaches CI logs and pull-request annotations. Strengthened after SeamSpec's reviewer: the finding's own annotation is checked, the ten-place limit is part of the rule and tested, and the message is pinned exactly so no fragment of a value can slip in.
